title: Board Policy on Capital Credits (Patronage Capital): Estate Discount Rate for Later Allocations by Patronage
content:
# Estate Discount Rate for Later Allocations by Patronage

**Policy — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), later distribution-margin allocations retired for an estate.**

The estate discount rate for a later distribution-margin allocation follows the member's patronage:

- where the member's last final-billed service account was final billed in the allocation's own year or later **and** the capital account was opened at least **180** full calendar months before the retirement, the row is discounted at **5.0 percent**;
- where that service account was final billed before the allocation's year **and** the account was opened fewer than 180 full calendar months before the retirement, the row is discounted at the patron class's early retirement discount rate — **7.5 percent** in every patron class;
- for every other estate row this rule sets no rate.

## Records read

- **Last final-billed service account:** from the deceased member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule records, the service account in final billed status and its final date. Only the calendar year of that final date is compared with the allocation year.
- **Account age:** the full calendar months from the date the capital account was opened up to the date of the retirement.

## Truth table

| Final billed in the allocation's year or later | Account open 180 full months or more | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 5.0 percent |
| No (final billed before the allocation's year) | No (fewer than 180 months) | 7.5 percent |
| Yes | No | not set by this rule |
| No | Yes | not set by this rule |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 2024 allocation)

| Final date | Months since opening | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2024-01-05 | 180 | 5.0 percent — final in the allocation's own year; 180 is "at least 180" |
| 2024-12-30 | 179 | not set by this rule |
| 2023-12-31 | 179 | 7.5 percent — final before 2024; 179 is fewer than 180 |
| 2023-12-31 | 180 | not set by this rule |
